title: Career Planning Program
summary: All levels from the Battalion/Squadron to the CG and affects every type of command unit (Air, Ground, Logistics, and Installations). 24 items across the program.
applicabilityLevel: All levels from the Battalion/Squadron to the CG and affects every type of command unit (Air, Ground, Logistics, and Installations)

source.title: IGMC Functional Area Checklist - Career Planning Program
source.publisher: Inspector General of the Marine Corps

subsections.title: COMMAND GROUP (Applies to all levels of Career Planning programs)

items.question: Does the command provide the Career Planner an appropriate working area and required resources per the references?
Does the command certify annually the Career Planner remains eligible for assignment incentive pay?
Does the command process Career Planner performance evaluations per the references? Reference MCO 1040.31, chap 1.3.b(e); MCO 1040R.31, chap 1.3.c(1)
Does the commanding officer grant written authority to conduct interviews on their behalf?
Does the Commanding Officer, or those delegated in writing to conduct EAS/RECC interviews, make reenlistment recommendations and assign appropriate reenlistment eligibility codes?
Does the Interview Management System or the examination of Career Planning Contact Records identify any missed Commanding Officer EAS/RECC interviews within the prescribed timeline?

Does the examination of the Commanding Officer EAS interviews confirm the following are being completed: reviewed the Marine's plans for separation, reiterated the advantages of remaining in the Marine Corps, informed the Marine about the benefits of joining the Selected Marine Corps Reserve and Transition Assistance Management Programs, and advised on the Marine 4 Life program as well as the mandatory pre-separation briefing requirement? Reference 1040.31, chap 3, Para 2b (3).
Does the Commanding Officer review all reenlistment approvals prior to executing the reenlistment? Note: Approved TFRS RELM
Does the Commanding Officer sign and date all RELM responses? Note: Additional sources in TFRS RELM responses; TFRS WEBSITE - training page
Does the Command Senior Enlisted Leader screen personnel within the command for assignment to special duty assignments, screen able “B” billets?
Does the Command Senior Enlisted Leader ensure the Commanders re-certification for special duty assignments and screenable “B” billets are conducted per the prescribed timelines?

subsections.title: UNIT CAREER PLANNER FUNCTIONS (Applies to any Career Planner program with an enlisted population.)

items.question: Does the Career Planner have additional duties that either require the preponderance of their time or compromise the Career Planner's position (SACO, Legal NCO, EOR, UTC).
Does the Career Planner maintain records per the references? MCO 1040.31, chap 6, para 1.b.; MCO1040R.31 chap 7, para 2.a; MCO 5210.11F, OMB M-19-21
Does the Interview Management System or examination of Career Planning Contact Records identify any missed Career Planner interviews within the prescribed timelines?

Does the examination of the Interview Management System and/or Career Planning Contact Records reveal the Career Planner is conducting interviews to gain an understanding of the true reasons why Marines do or do not desire to reenlist? Reference MCO 1040.31, chap 3, para 1.c.; MCO 1040R.31, chap 3, par 1.c.

Does the examination of the First Term interviews confirm the Career Planner fulfilled the following tasks: fully apprised the Marine of the benefits of a Marine Corps career and incentives related to reenlistment, the need for a complete and competitive performance record, determined if the Marine meets all prerequisites for reenlistment/lateral move, advised the Marine on any required corrective action is initiated if necessary (for example, retaking the AFQT) and familiarized the Marine with the FTAP process?

Does the examination of the Careerist interview confirm that the Career Planner fulfilled the following tasks: advised the career Marine of current options and benefits such as SRBP and special duty assignments, determined reenlistment eligibility, and, if applicable, counseled the Marine on enlisted career force controls and involuntary separation pay? Reference 1040.31, chap 3, Para 2b (2).

Does the examination of the EAS interviews confirm that the Career Planner fulfilled the following tasks: reviewed the Marine's plans for separation, reiterated the advantages of remaining in the Marine Corps, informed the Marine about the benefits of joining the Selected Marine Corps Reserve and Transition Assistance Management Programs, and advised on the Marine 4 Life program as well as the mandatory pre-separation briefing requirement? Reference 1040.31, chap 3, Para 2b (3).
Does examination of the Interview Management System reveal the Career Planner properly documented, completed, and archived interviews?
Does examination of the Interview Management System reveal during required interviews, that the Career Planner educates Marines on required topics?
Does the Career Planner, and requesting Marine sign and date all RELM responses? Note: Additional sources in TFRS RELM responses; TFRS WEBSITE - training page
Does the Career Planner accurately complete the NAVMC 321a (Agreement to Extend Enlistment), DD Form 4(Reenlistment Contract), and required Statement of Understanding(s)?

subsections.title: CAREER PLANNER STAFF NONCOMMISSIONED OFFICER-IN-CHARGE (SNCOIC) (Applies to all Career Planners in a SNCOIC billet)

items.question: Does the SNCOIC conduct, and document required 2000/2500 level individual training events for subordinate Career Planners per the references? Note: Additional sources are Advanced Tools for Coaching (AT4C) Participant Guide, T&R Manual

Does the Career Planner SNCOIC facilitate the implementation of the retention plan within the command? Note: Additional sources are Current FY Retention Campaign Plans (MARADMINs); Current TFRS Messages
Does the Career Planner SNCOIC advise the Commanders on Marine Corps enlisted retention matters?
Does the SNCOIC conduct quality control on all RELM requests submitted by subordinate commands? Note: Additional sources are Current TFRS Messages, Current FY Retention Campaign Plan MARADMIN

Does the SNCOIC conduct Career Planner evaluations to evaluate the effectiveness and knowledge of subordinate Career Planners? Note: Additional sources are Advanced Tools for Coaching (AT4C) Participant Guide, T&R MANUAL

subsections.title: RESERVE COMMAND GROUP (Applies to commands with a Reserve Monitor Command Code)

items.question: Does the Commanding Officer or Inspector Instructor assign Collateral Duty Career Planners who meets the requirements for each unit/site without an assigned PMOS 4821 Career Planner?
Does the command facilitate Collateral Duty Career Planners completion a Reserve Career Planner Course within one year of assignment?
Does the Career Planner / Career Planner SNCOIC conduct annual site visits within the command?
